heading: Today
text: Areas of river valley fog, then mostly sunny and seasonably cool.  Highs in the low to mid 60s.  Winds light, mainly northeast less than 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear and chilly.  Areas of dense river valley fog. Scattered frost in the cold spots.  Lows in the 30s to low 40s, some cold spots north near 32.  Winds diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Thursday
text: Valley fog burning off to sunshine, mixing with some clouds south and east.  Highs in the low to mid 60s.  Winds light, becoming north to northeast up to 10 mph.
